name: Motherson Warren
old_description: The Motherson Group is a globally operating supplier providing full system solutions to the automotive industry, from design, simulation and prototyping to tooling, moulding, painting and final assembly of highly integrated modules. The group was founded in 1975 and is today one of the 22 largest and fastest growing automotive component makers in the world.
about:
Samvardhana Motherson Reflectec (SMR) operates its North American hub in Warren, Michigan, as part of the Motherson Group founded in 1975. The group grew into one of the 22 largest automotive suppliers worldwide, though the INPUT does not specify the ownership structure or individual founders.

SMR develops and manufactures rear-view mirror systems and intelligent camera technologies for automakers. Its manufacturing portfolio spans design, simulation, prototyping, tooling, moulding, painting and final assembly of integrated modules, from simple plastic components to complex assemblies with world-class surfaces and embedded electrical functions. The company employs more than 10,400 people globally and holds a 24 percent share of the worldwide exterior-mirror market.

The division supplies nearly every major automotive manufacturer across North America, Europe, Asia and Australia, providing interior and exterior mirrors as well as camera-based environment sensors.

SMR states its mission as delivering "perfect vision while driving with a maximum of safety and comfort," positioning its mirror and camera systems as safety-critical technologies.
